review_evidence: README identifies the project as interest theory in Lean.
13 of 14 Lean files contain proposition declarations, including annuity identities, monotonicity and limiting-value theorems, Redington-style results, and analytic uniqueness/existence lemmas.
The corpus contains a broad mathematical proof development rather than merely executable finance code.
summary: Reviewed interest; retain the substantive actuarial interest-theory formalization.
